content.text:
**Finding: deviation (§ 3.4 Termination for Convenience)**

- Customer's convenience right exists on one month's notice, and IBM has no convenience right anywhere in the Agreement (§ 3.3 is cause-only; § 11.3 is cause-based) — both consistent with our preferred position.
- The deviation is the condition in 3.4(b): uncapped early termination charges defined outside the Base Terms (Attachment A / Service Option Attachments), with no refund of prepaid charges (§ 3.5 only accelerates Customer's payments).
- Redline (validated ok:true): replaced 3.4(b) so Customer pays only accrued charges, IBM refunds prepaid charges pro-rata, and no early termination penalty applies; comment offers the fallback cap of three months' charges.
